mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising labor demand (PAYEMS) indicates stronger job market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite PAYEMS rising, or IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the supply index (INDPRO) reflects expanding production capacity and potential inflationary pressures, driving investor optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite INDPRO rising, or IC remains below 0.03 over any 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained crossing below 4.5% in the federal funds rate triggers a monetary easing cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS crossing below 4.5%, or IC remains above 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 4.5% signals a tight labor market, reducing wage growth expectations and boosting corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 4.5%, or IC < 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling federal funds rates (monetary easing) and rising demand (GDPC1) creates a dual signal of accommodative policy and robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both FEDFUNDS declining and GDPC1 rising, or IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in demand (GDPC1) and labor demand (PAYEMS) indicate strong economic momentum, fostering optimism about corporate earnings and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both GDPC1 and PAYEMS rising, or IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime (INDPRO > 110), a decline in the federal funds rate below 4.0% signals further accommodative monetary policy, amplifying investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the trigger occurring, or IC remains below 0.03 over any 6-month window.
